title: Android Unlock Patterns
goal: Count valid Android unlock patterns with lengths between m and n.
strategy: A move across a grid key is allowed only when that intermediate key has already been visited. Subset DP tracks the visited mask and final key, preserving all legal ordering counts without enumerating every full path.
